content.short: Tide is a UK business banking and finance platform for SMEs with accounts, cards, invoicing and loans.
content.description: Tide is a business financial platform serving small and medium enterprises, most prominently in the UK and India, with a mission to save owners time on their finances. It offers free business current and savings accounts, cards, invoicing, card readers and tap-to-pay, integrated accounting and payroll software, business loans and alternative finance, and even company registration. Rather than being a fully licensed bank itself, Tide provides FSCS-protected accounts through ClearBank and is FCA-authorised for e-money, bundling banking with the back-office tools freelancers and SMEs need. With more than two million members and over 1.6 billion pounds in funding facilitated, it competes with banks and other challengers on admin-light business finance.
